preconditions.description: The domain behavior is understood well enough to model events without a prototype.
A third-party API, crate integration, or performance boundary is uncertain and needs de-risking.

A promotion-style decision (hold or promote) is recorded in an epic row and mirrored in plans/invariants.json. The gate is check-promotions, which validates every recorded decision against the shipped Cargo defaults; it is decision-agnostic (it names no single feature), so it serves AGT and mcp-surface alike. A drift in any recorded decision fails this gate, by design: the check is a whole-repository coherence invariant, not a per-task probe.
